title: Rust: ownership, reliable systems and Arrow data engineering
summary: 48 detailed lessons from first programs through language mechanisms, reliable systems and independently designed projects.

lessons.title: Source, compilation and the first Rust program
lessons.outcome: Compile and run a Rust program and check a computed value with assert_eq! instead of trusting printed text.
lessons.lab: Compute the capacity of three shelves with eight books each.
lessons.verification: Three shelves of eight books hold 24 books.

lessons.title: Bindings, mutability and type inference
lessons.outcome: Use immutable and mutable bindings deliberately and read the types the compiler infers.
lessons.lab: Write a running total with fixed input and mutable accumulator.
lessons.verification: The running total ends at 10 and the input array is unchanged.

lessons.title: Integer range, checked arithmetic and numerical intent
lessons.outcome: Choose checked, wrapping or saturating integer arithmetic on purpose and handle overflow explicitly.
lessons.lab: Write a checked quantity-total calculation returning an explicit failure.
lessons.verification: 125 cents times 3 is Ok(375); u64::MAX times 2 is an explicit Err.

lessons.title: String ownership, UTF-8 and text boundaries
lessons.outcome: Work with owned String and borrowed &str and index UTF-8 text only at valid boundaries.
lessons.lab: Write a function accepting &str and returning its byte length.
lessons.verification: pear has 4 bytes, é has 2 and café has 5.

lessons.title: Expressions, branches and exhaustive matches
lessons.outcome: Write exhaustive match and if expressions that cover every case, including boundaries.
lessons.lab: Write a negative, zero and positive classifier.
lessons.verification: -4, 0 and 9 are classified as negative, zero and positive.

lessons.title: Loops, iterators and termination evidence
lessons.outcome: Write loops and iterator searches that terminate and report not-found with Option.
lessons.lab: Implement a first-match search with Option output.
lessons.verification: The first 7 is at index 1; a missing target and an empty slice give None.

lessons.title: Functions, return values and contracts
lessons.outcome: Write pure functions with documented valid ranges and checks for them.
lessons.lab: Write a pure rectangle-area function with a documented valid range.
lessons.verification: 3 by 4 gives 12, a zero side gives 0, and the documented maximum still fits in u32.

lessons.title: Ownership, moves and explicit cloning
lessons.outcome: Predict moves and clones and transfer ownership into and out of functions.
lessons.lab: Write a function taking and returning an owned String.
lessons.verification: The returned String is ready! and ownership has moved into louder.

lessons.title: Shared borrowing and scope
lessons.outcome: Write functions that borrow shared data and return slices tied to their input.
lessons.lab: Write a last-word function returning a borrowed slice.
lessons.verification: The last word of pear apple is apple; empty text gives an empty slice.

lessons.title: Exclusive borrowing and mutation boundaries
lessons.outcome: Mutate data through exclusive borrows, including split borrows of one slice.
lessons.lab: Write a function swapping the ends of a mutable slice safely.
lessons.verification: [1, 2, 3] becomes [3, 2, 1], and an empty slice is left alone.

lessons.title: Slices, arrays and vector growth
lessons.outcome: Accept slices instead of owned collections and handle empty input explicitly.
lessons.lab: Implement a maximum function accepting a slice and returning Option.
lessons.verification: The maximum of 3, 9 and 4 is Some(9); an empty slice gives None.

lessons.title: Structs, methods and validated state
lessons.outcome: Encapsulate state in structs with private fields and methods that keep invariants.
lessons.lab: Create a bounded counter with private state and validated operations.
lessons.verification: Two increments succeed, the third is refused, and the value stays at the limit 2.

lessons.title: Enums and state-specific payloads
lessons.outcome: Model states with enums whose variants carry only their own data, handled by exhaustive matches.
lessons.lab: Model an import as pending, completed or rejected with state-specific information.
lessons.verification: The three states render as pending:2, done:5 and rejected:bad header.

lessons.title: Option and preserving missing information
lessons.outcome: Represent missing values with Option and transform them without losing absence.
lessons.lab: Write a first-valid-item lookup returning Option.
lessons.verification: The first valid item in -2, 0, 5 is Some(0); no valid item gives None.

lessons.title: Result, error propagation and recoverable failure
lessons.outcome: Propagate recoverable errors with Result and ? while keeping each failure meaningful.
lessons.lab: Write a function using ? to compose two fallible steps.
lessons.verification: 4 doubles to Ok(8); bad text and -3 return their original errors.

lessons.title: Foundation project: a validated inventory report
lessons.outcome: Build a validated inventory importer that reports sorted totals and rejected rows.
lessons.lab: Render the sorted map with an explicit rejected count.
lessons.verification: The report lists apple: 3, pear: 2 and rejected: 1.

lessons.title: Traits and behavioral contracts
lessons.outcome: Define traits as behavioral contracts and use them through generics and trait objects.
lessons.lab: Define a small trait for a deterministic formatter.
lessons.verification: The formatter turns 3 into 3 units, identically on every call.

lessons.title: Generics, bounds and associated types
lessons.outcome: Write generic functions and types with the trait bounds they actually need.
lessons.lab: Create a generic pair that swaps owned elements.
lessons.verification: Swapping (left, right) gives (right, left) without cloning either String.

lessons.title: Lifetime parameters and borrowed API design
lessons.outcome: Design borrowed APIs with the narrowest lifetime relationships the compiler can check.
lessons.lab: Write a borrowed prefix parser with the narrowest lifetime relationship.
lessons.verification: The rest of qty:42 is Some("42"), still usable after the prefix String is dropped.

lessons.title: Iterators, laziness and consumption
lessons.outcome: Build lazy iterator pipelines and know when consumption happens.
lessons.lab: Write a borrowed transformation returning a collected result.
lessons.verification: The result is PEAR and FIG, and the borrowed input is unchanged.

lessons.title: Closures and Fn capability bounds
lessons.outcome: Write closures and choose Fn, FnMut or FnOnce bounds by what the closure does.
lessons.lab: Implement a helper accepting FnMut for repeated transformations.
lessons.verification: Doubling three times turns 1 into 8.

lessons.title: Custom errors and preserving causes
lessons.outcome: Define custom error types that keep their causes reachable through source.
lessons.lab: Define a custom error for an importer with syntax and storage boundaries.
lessons.verification: The syntax error names line 3; the storage error keeps the disk full cause reachable through source.

lessons.title: Modules, visibility and a stable public surface
lessons.outcome: Organize code into modules with a small, stable public surface.
lessons.lab: Move a pure domain operation into an inline module.
lessons.verification: pricing::total(4, 5) is Some(20); an overflowing total is None.

lessons.title: Tests, assertions and useful counterexamples
lessons.outcome: Write table-driven tests whose counterexamples reject plausible wrong implementations.
lessons.lab: Write table-driven checks for a quantity validator.
lessons.verification: All four rows pass, including both edges of the 0 to 1000 range.

lessons.title: Files, bytes and owned cleanup
lessons.outcome: Write and read files as bytes or UTF-8 and remove owned temporary files on every path.
lessons.lab: Create an owned temporary-file round trip for a report.
lessons.verification: The report reads back unchanged and the temporary file is removed.

lessons.title: Maps, sets and algorithmic cost
lessons.outcome: Choose BTreeMap, HashMap and sets for deterministic output and predictable cost.
lessons.lab: Build a deterministic frequency report.
lessons.verification: The report is apple=1, fig=1, pear=2, always in that order.

lessons.title: Scoped threads and explicit joins
lessons.outcome: Run work on scoped threads that borrow local data and join results back to the parent.
lessons.lab: Build a scoped parallel computation returning values to the parent.
lessons.verification: The halves sum to 6 and 15, together 21, the same as the sequential sum.

lessons.title: Arc, Mutex and compound shared invariants
lessons.outcome: Share state across threads with Arc and Mutex while protecting compound invariants.
lessons.lab: Implement a locked bounded reservation operation.
lessons.verification: Of four concurrent requests for 2 units from a stock of 5, exactly two succeed and 1 unit remains.

lessons.title: Channels, backpressure and completion
lessons.outcome: Connect threads with bounded channels and finish pipelines by dropping senders.
lessons.lab: Build a bounded producer-consumer report pipeline.
lessons.verification: The consumer reports qty=3, qty=5 and qty=2 in order and then stops.

lessons.title: Send, Sync and type-driven concurrency safety
lessons.outcome: Use Send and Sync to explain which types the compiler lets cross thread boundaries.
lessons.lab: Choose a safe shared-state type for a small concurrent counter.
lessons.verification: Four threads adding 100 each produce exactly 400.

lessons.title: Box, Rc, Weak and recursive structures
lessons.outcome: Build recursive and shared structures with Box, Rc and Weak without reference cycles.
lessons.lab: Model a parent-child relationship with a weak back-reference.
lessons.verification: The child finds root while the parent lives, the parent keeps one strong count, and after it is dropped the back-reference upgrades to None.

lessons.title: Composition project: a reusable inventory library
lessons.outcome: Build and test a reusable library crate through its documented Cargo commands.
lessons.lab: Reproduce Example A (Create a stable report) and Example B (Retain rejected input evidence) and explain each check.
lessons.verification: The report accumulates duplicates and orders keys. Two invalid rows are counted and a valid zero remains present.

lessons.title: Futures, async syntax and executor boundaries
lessons.outcome: Explain how futures are polled and woken and what an executor owns.
lessons.lab: Reproduce Example A (Poll a ready computation) and Example B (Observe pending without spinning) and explain each check.
lessons.verification: The immediately ready future yields seven on its first poll. The pending future reports no completed value.

lessons.title: Unsafe code, FFI and a documented safety argument
lessons.outcome: Write a safety argument before any unsafe code and keep unsafe behind a safe API.
lessons.lab: Write a safe wrapper specification before considering an unsafe implementation.
lessons.verification: first_two returns Some((4, 5)) for three values and None for one.

lessons.title: Memory layout, allocation and performance evidence
lessons.outcome: Measure memory and performance with evidence instead of assumptions about allocation.
lessons.lab: Write a benchmark plan comparing repeated clone with borrowed processing.
lessons.verification: Both versions return the same total, so a benchmark compares only their cost.

lessons.title: Cargo, editions and reproducible release workflows
lessons.outcome: Explain editions, lockfiles and offline builds, and show an edition 2024 rule that changes compilation.
lessons.lab: Reproduce Example A (Observe an edition 2024 scope rule) and Example B (Iterate a boxed slice by value) and explain each check.
lessons.verification: name_length compiles and returns 4 under edition 2024; edition 2021 rejects the same function with E0597. into_iter on a Box<[String]> yields owned Strings under edition 2024; under edition 2021 the same call yields &String and the collect fails with E0277.

lessons.title: Arrow columnar memory and typed arrays
lessons.outcome: Build typed Arrow arrays and read values through the Array trait.
lessons.lab: Construct paired integer and text columns with equal row counts.
lessons.verification: Both columns have 3 rows, and row 1 pairs apple with 5.

lessons.title: Arrow nulls, validity and NaN semantics
lessons.outcome: Distinguish null, NaN and valid values in Arrow arrays.
lessons.lab: Write a summary returning valid, null and finite counts.
lessons.verification: Four slots give 3 valid values, 1 null and 2 finite values.

lessons.title: Schemas, fields and RecordBatch invariants
lessons.outcome: Build RecordBatches whose schema and column lengths are checked at construction.
lessons.lab: Construct a batch for a small validated inventory dataset.
lessons.verification: The negative apple row is rejected before construction, leaving a batch of 2 rows and 2 columns.

lessons.title: Compute kernels, filtering and row selection
lessons.outcome: Filter and take Arrow rows with compute kernels so every column stays aligned.
lessons.lab: Filter every column of a batch consistently under one row mask.
lessons.verification: Filtering keeps rows 0 and 2 in every column: pear and kiwi with their quantities.

lessons.title: Variable-width arrays, nested values and zero-copy slices
lessons.outcome: Build nested and variable-width Arrow columns and slice them without copying.
lessons.lab: Build a nested column from a small ragged dataset.
lessons.verification: The nested column holds 3 lists with lengths 2, 0 and 1.

lessons.title: Arrow IPC and explicit stream completion
lessons.outcome: Round-trip RecordBatches through Arrow IPC streams with explicit completion.
lessons.lab: Build an in-memory IPC round trip preserving a nullable column.
lessons.verification: The restored batch equals the original, including its single null.

lessons.title: CSV and JSON readers with explicit schemas
lessons.outcome: Read CSV and JSON into Arrow with an explicit schema and validate domain rules afterward.
lessons.lab: Read a small nullable dataset and validate its domain ranges afterward.
lessons.verification: Reading succeeds with 3 rows, 1 null and 1 negative value that the domain check then reports.

lessons.title: Cross-language data contracts: decimals, timestamps and metadata
lessons.outcome: Record units, decimal scale and timestamp precision in Arrow schemas for other languages.
lessons.lab: Create a schema documenting measurement units and timestamp precision.
lessons.verification: The mass field records unit kg and the timestamp field records millisecond UTC precision.

lessons.title: Bounded batch pipelines and data accounting
lessons.outcome: Process data in bounded batches while accounting for every accepted and rejected row.
lessons.lab: Apply the same accounting to an Arrow batch reader.
lessons.verification: Across two batches, 5 rows split into 3 accepted and 2 rejected.

lessons.title: Diagnostics, security boundaries and safe output
lessons.outcome: Emit safe diagnostic events and enforce allowlisted permissions at trust boundaries.
lessons.lab: Instrument an importer with submitted, accepted and rejected counts.
lessons.verification: The event reads submitted=4 accepted=2 rejected=2.

lessons.title: Properties, compile-fail cases and regression design
lessons.outcome: Design property tests and regression checks that would fail for a broken implementation.
lessons.lab: Write a property checking an Arrow filter's output count against its Boolean mask.
lessons.verification: For all 16 masks over four rows, the filtered length equals the number of true entries.

lessons.title: Capstone: a validated Arrow analytical report
lessons.outcome: Build a validated Arrow report with honest accounting and round-trip it through IPC.
lessons.lab: Build a multi-column RecordBatch report and round-trip it through IPC.
lessons.verification: The two-column report round-trips unchanged and the stream ends after one batch.
